## QUESTION 1

1. __Convert values to missing__ 

Start with a fresh copy of the flights dataset by reading it in from the link provided above (as opposed to starting with the dataset you ended with in the last assignment). Identify data values that are problematic, non-sense or impossible and change them to be missing. 

In your report include one record example (one row) from your clean data, in the raw JSON format. Your example should display at least one missing value so that we can verify it was done correctly. (Note: JSON will convert NaN's to null).

 Describe your process for finding values that needed to be changed, and how you changed them.

First, I saw that num_of_delays_carrier returned as a string and it should be an int. year, minutes_delayed_carrier, and minutes_delayed_nas returned null values.  num_of_delays_late_aircraft and minutes_delayed_nas returned the min value of -999, which is impossible. The min airport_name returned "", and the max month returned n/a. All of these need to be replaced.

In order to replace them I will create new columns. I will first replace airport_name and month invalid data for None. Then, I will convert the text column into numbers and then correct the data. Last, I will fix the -999 values.

```{python}
# Include and execute your code here
df.schema
# num_of_delays_carrier returned as a string and it should be an int

df.null_count()
# year, minutes_delayed_carrier, and minutes_delayed_nas returned null values 

df.describe()
# num_of_delays_late_aircraft and minutes_delayed_nas returned the min value of -999, which is impossible. min airport_name returned "", max month returned n/a. All of these need to be replaced

# In order to replace them I will create new columns 

flights_without_invalid_data = df.with_columns(

  # I will first replace airport_name and month invalid data for None
  pl.col("airport_name").replace({"": None}),
  pl.col("month").replace({"n/a": None}),

  # I will convert the text column into numbers and then correct the data
  pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False),

  # Last I will fix the -999 values
  pl.when(pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft") == -999).then(None).otherwise(pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft")).alias("num_of_delays_late_aircraft"),
      
    pl.when(pl.col("minutes_delayed_nas") == -999).then(None).otherwise(pl.col("minutes_delayed_nas")).alias("minutes_delayed_nas")
)

# JSON line

json_line_with_null = flights_without_invalid_data.filter(pl.col("month").is_null() | pl.col("airport_name").is_null() | pl.col("minutes_delayed_nas").is_null()).head(1)

print(json_line_with_null.write_json())


```
